associations.rationale: The root-of-unity-sum result supports the cyclotomic-field assertion, but the displayed type does not itself visibly state membership in a cyclotomic field.
The conditional character-power equality supports the claimed Galois-action behavior, but the displayed type does not itself identify sigma as that Galois action.
The displayed type states only that a particular product of character values is fixed by the ring homomorphism; it does not identify that product as beta.
